scope: Independent fixed SQL on own readonly MySQL AdventureWorks; FLOAT source tolerance is documented, no currency or governed financial precision certification. A current uniqueness observation is not a unique constraint.

queries.annual: SELECT YEAR(h.OrderDate) AS year,COUNT(*) AS order_count,SUM(h.SubTotal) AS revenue,SUM(h.SubTotal)/COUNT(*) AS average_order_value FROM salesorderheader h WHERE h.Status=5 AND h.OnlineOrderFlag=1 AND h.OrderDate>=%s AND h.OrderDate<%s GROUP BY YEAR(h.OrderDate) ORDER BY year
queries.region: SELECT YEAR(h.OrderDate) AS year,COALESCE(t.Name,'未知区域') AS region,COUNT(*) AS order_count,SUM(h.SubTotal) AS revenue FROM salesorderheader h LEFT JOIN salesterritory t ON t.TerritoryID=h.TerritoryID WHERE h.Status=5 AND h.OnlineOrderFlag=1 AND h.OrderDate>=%s AND h.OrderDate<%s GROUP BY YEAR(h.OrderDate),COALESCE(t.Name,'未知区域') ORDER BY year,region
queries.category: SELECT YEAR(h.OrderDate) AS year,COALESCE(c.Name,'未分类') AS category,SUM(d.LineTotal) AS revenue,COUNT(*) AS detail_rows FROM salesorderheader h JOIN salesorderdetail d ON d.SalesOrderID=h.SalesOrderID LEFT JOIN product p ON p.ProductID=d.ProductID LEFT JOIN productsubcategory s ON s.ProductSubcategoryID=p.ProductSubcategoryID LEFT JOIN productcategory c ON c.ProductCategoryID=s.ProductCategoryID WHERE h.Status=5 AND h.OnlineOrderFlag=1 AND h.OrderDate>=%s AND h.OrderDate<%s GROUP BY YEAR(h.OrderDate),COALESCE(c.Name,'未分类') ORDER BY year,category
queries.repeat: SELECT year,COUNT(*) AS active_customers,SUM(order_count>=2) AS repeat_customers,SUM(order_count>=2)/COUNT(*) AS repeat_rate FROM (SELECT YEAR(h.OrderDate) AS year,h.CustomerID,COUNT(DISTINCT h.SalesOrderID) AS order_count FROM salesorderheader h WHERE h.Status=5 AND h.OnlineOrderFlag=1 AND h.OrderDate>=%s AND h.OrderDate<%s GROUP BY YEAR(h.OrderDate),h.CustomerID) x GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
queries.grain_check: SELECT YEAR(h.OrderDate) AS year,COUNT(*) AS joined_rows,COUNT(DISTINCT h.SalesOrderID) AS distinct_orders,SUM(d.LineTotal) AS detail_revenue,SUM(h.SubTotal) AS incorrectly_repeated_header_revenue FROM salesorderheader h JOIN salesorderdetail d ON d.SalesOrderID=h.SalesOrderID WHERE h.Status=5 AND h.OnlineOrderFlag=1 AND h.OrderDate>=%s AND h.OrderDate<%s GROUP BY YEAR(h.OrderDate) ORDER BY year
